title: Retire unused Circle header helper and restore active About formatting

source.ref: Actual Frequency metadata subline, human About and owning Space context

detail: The old PageHero-specific purpose-summary helper had only its own unit-test importer. The active Frequency Circle already renders member/type/place metadata under the title and retains human About content separately, with an owning Space header when appropriate. Remove only the obsolete helper/test pair, correct historical layout commentary, and migrate LIVE385's stale helper-name guard to actual JSX plus all surviving content/storage/engagement boundaries. Actual server-rendered fixtures hold metadata, escaped human content, one primary heading and Space-context h2 behavior. The same review found the active Frequency About had regressed to a raw text paragraph while the old guard checked an unused formatter. Restore the existing richParagraphs safe parser in the active shell: actual rendered fixtures cover paragraphs, bold, italic, safe links, rejected unsafe protocols and escaped HTML. No raw HTML, saved Circle data or database changes; browser acceptance remains distinct.
